sources.title: Vote Vancouver platform: Let's get Vancouver working again
sources.notes: Platform hub: 'The Vancouver Test' framework plus links to five platform sections (housing, economy, public safety, transportation, public services).

sources.title: Housing & Belonging: Stay in the city you call home
sources.notes: Housing platform: community land trusts/co-ops on public land, supportive housing with services, faster approvals, middle-income homes on public land, faith-land redevelopment, Affordable Housing Endowment Fund, seniors (NORCs).

sources.title: Public Safety: Safe streets and a stronger Downtown Eastside
sources.notes: Public-safety platform: health-led response, lift supportive-housing ban, 'housing over incarceration', treat substance use as health issue, Recovery Community Centres, expand St. Paul's Road to Recovery.

sources.title: Economic Drivers: Make a good living in Vancouver
sources.notes: Economic platform: Small Business Concierge, faster permits, western HQ strategy, childcare on underused City land, major events, vacant City storefronts.

sources.title: Transportation Choice: Get where you need to go, faster and cheaper
sources.notes: Transportation platform: free transit for under-18s, fix streetlights within 72h, complete Broadway bike lane, SkyTrain to UBC, free seasonal bike valets, 10 pedestrian plazas, electric passenger ferry, parking.

sources.title: Public Services: Love your community
sources.notes: Public-services platform: City Hall service access, Seniors Desk, Neighbourhood Hubs, community centres/libraries/pools, community use of schools, 30% tree-canopy target, climate action.

sources.title: The Blueprint: A Plan for the Working Class
sources.notes: Platform overview: five pillars (Roots Project housing, The Pulse transit, Universal Care, Aurora Engine local economy, Pure Vancouver fair share); headline items 20% rent-to-equity, free transit for residents, 21-day deemed permits, 2% surcharge on $5M+ properties.

sources.title: The Roots Project: Real Ownership for Real Vancouverites
sources.notes: Housing pillar: rent-to-own Roots Equity Trust (20% of rent), permanent affordable rentals, Local Buyers First (bulk-buying cap), family-sized/pet-inclusive housing; 2,000-home first-term target.

sources.title: The Pulse: Safe, Affordable, and Modern Transit for All
sources.notes: Transit pillar: phased fare relief, platform safety gates pilot, UBC SkyTrain corridor prep, faster core bus routes, public delivery tracking.

sources.title: Universal Care: Practical Support for Working Families
sources.notes: Care pillar: night-shift childcare, treatment-first crisis response, accessible civic spaces, faster care-clinic permits using City land/permits/zoning.

sources.title: The Aurora Engine (local economy pillar)
sources.notes: Local-economy pillar: faster permits, affordable food access, worker training, lower building costs (page confirmed reachable; detail not extracted).

sources.title: Pure Vancouver: Securing Our Foundations
sources.notes: Fair-share pillar: marginal Luxury Infrastructure Levy on homes assessed above $5M (needs provincial authority), Vancouver Foundations Fund, school-safety acceleration, intergenerational hubs, empty-homes accountability.
